title: Document Conversion Workflow
definition: A comprehensive guide for converting documents between Markdown and PDF formats, with optional conversion to plain text.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A step-by-step guide to convert files between Markdown and PDF. This also includes an optional step to convert PDFs to plain text.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A guide that discusses the use of pandoc and libreoffice for document conversion. It covers Markdown to PDF, PDF to plain text, and PDF to Markdown.
difficulty_levels.expert: A guide that delves into the inner workings of document conversion. It discusses the limitations of different conversion methods, best practices for document preservation, and the philosophical implications of format conversion.

extra_fields.insight: Learning about the intricacies and limitations of document conversion can lead to a deeper understanding of the digital landscape.
